title: psxstack game description
description: Static facts about a game, read at configure time by psxstack_add_game() and generated into psxstack_game_gen.h. Nothing reads it at run time. GAME_CONTRACT.md "1. game.json". Addresses and sizes are hex strings ("0x80082CB0") or integers.

address.description: A PS1 address or a byte count: a hex string or an integer.

id.description: The game's short name: the port executable (<id>, <id>.exe), the launcher (<id>-launcher), the per-user settings directory (SDL_GetPrefPath('', id)), the cache directory (<id>-port), the data section prefix (<id>_data_<overlay>).

title.description: The game's title as shown: window titles, the launcher, the packages.

discs.description: The disc images the port accepts. The port and the launcher check the whole BIN's SHA-1 against this list; the error names the labels. Empty for a disc-free program (examples/hello): the port then takes no --disc and the launcher has no disc screen to pass.

label.description: A noun phrase for the messages, completing "This is <label>." and "<file> is not <label>": "the unpatched European disc (SLES-03936)".

sha1.description: Of the whole BIN (every sector, 2352 bytes each).

cue.description: The expected .cue file name, for the launcher's hint. Optional.

rate.description: The nominal vsyncs per second the game is made for (the audio's samples per vsync follow it).

rates.description: The rates the launcher offers (default: [rate]). A rate other than `rate` is passed to the game's game_apply_rate().

rate_note.description: The launcher's explanation of the alternative rate (dw2003: the NTSC patch's 60 Hz mode).

ram.description: The PS1's RAM as the game addresses it: 0x80000000, 0x200000 (KSEG0). An address outside it is a host pointer to the overlay resolver.

slots.description: The overlay slots in address order, contiguous with each other and with the heap: the arena is laid out at these distances so a pointer's PS1-style address is slots[0].base + its offset. Slot n (1-based) is `tier` n in the hook macros.

name.description: For logs and the generated macros' comments: "stage", "file".

heap.description: The heap the stack manages in the arena, right after the last slot (the HEAP_* hook macros). Optional: a game whose heap is its own data (an array in its .bss, as the second game's) leaves it out; the arena then holds the slots alone, and a use of a HEAP_* macro fails to compile.

start.description: The PS1 heap's first address (right after the last slot).

host_size.description: The host heap region's size; larger than the PS1's because 64-bit structs grow. Default 0x400000.

bios_standin.description: Reads the game makes from the BIOS ROM (0x1FC00000..): the stand-in holds `text` at `address`.

about.description: One line under the title: "Digimon World 2003 (Europe, SLES-03936) on the PC port."

disc_hint.description: The launcher's disc screen: what the game needs, one or two sentences ("Nothing is unpacked or copied." is added).
